memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild headache 2-3 days/week, manages work as accountant, no difficulty with ADLs.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds, low fall risk.
medicines: 0 regular (none prescribed yet).
mood: reports low mood, anhedonia, PHQ-9 to be checked.
carers: none.
goal: "I want to control my headaches and feel better day to day."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
propranolol 40 mg OD
sumatriptan 50 mg SOS

naproxen 500 mg SOS
sertraline 50 mg OD

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Neurological examination: normal cranial nerves, no focal deficits, normal coordination.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: headaches reduced to 1 day/week, able to work full days.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5, stable.
falls: 0 falls, gait normal, TUG 9 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (propranolol, sumatriptan PRN, topiramate, naproxen PRN, sertraline). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria.
mood: reports improved mood, PHQ-9 6 (mild).
carers: none.
goal: "I’d like to keep headaches rare and avoid medication side effects."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: headaches occasional (<1 per week), mild, no work loss.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw abnormal) – positive screen, plan for full cognitive assessment.
falls: 0 falls, gait normal, TUG 9 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (propranolol, topiramate, naproxen PRN, sumatriptan PRN, sertraline 75 mg). Polypharmacy – review Beers.

carers: none.
goal: "I want to feel more stable emotionally and reduce migraine days."

memories.text:
